claims.evidence: Appendix A specifies data-dependent top-10 mode and HCD-generated product ions.
Appendix A describes sequential rLysC followed by overnight trypsin; final enzyme is represented in one-column SDRF.
PRIDE processing protocol and paper Appendix A explicitly specify fixed C carbamidomethyl and variable M oxidation, N-terminal acetyl, N/Q deamidation, pyro-Glu Q/E, and hydroxyproline (oxidation P).

limitations: Archaeological paint contains possible protein binders from multiple animals; organism is not applicable at source level rather than broadcasting project-level pig/sheep identifications.
PRIDE README maps Blank_930 to the earlier set and Blank_1943 to the later set by sequential run IDs; no explicit year is given for each blank.
A single cleavage-agent column represents final trypsin digest; earlier Lys-C is documented in the paper.
The yellow early aliquot was analysed in 2017 per README, despite its 2016files filename and grouping in early set.
